senses.gloss: भौत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Demoniacal; 2. relating to living beings; 3. elemental.
भौत (II) m. An attendant upon idols.
भौत (III) n. An assemblage of evil spirits.
भौत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Demoniacal; 2. relating to living beings; 3. elemental.
भौतिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to living beings, M.iii.74; 2. relating to evil spirits; 3. elemental, material, पिंडेष्वनास्था खलु भौतिकेषु R.ii.57.
भौतिक (II) m. An epithet of Śiva.
भौतिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to living beings, M.iii.74; 2. relating to evil spirits; 3. elemental, material, पिंडेष्वनास्था खलु भौतिकेषु R.ii.57.
